declarations.name: QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix.eq_2
declarations.type:
∀ {F : Type u_1} {rowOne : Type u_2} {colOne : Type u_3} {rowTwo : Type u_4} {colTwo : Type u_5} [inst : Field F]
  [inst_1 : Fintype rowOne] [inst_2 : DecidableEq rowOne] [inst_3 : Fintype colOne] [inst_4 : DecidableEq colOne]
  [inst_5 : Fintype rowTwo] [inst_6 : DecidableEq rowTwo] [inst_7 : Fintype colTwo] [inst_8 : DecidableEq colTwo]
  (D : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data F rowOne colOne rowTwo colTwo) (r₁ : rowOne) (c₂ : colTwo) (r₁' : rowOne)
  (r₂ : rowTwo),
  QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix D (r₁, c₂) (Sum.inr (r₁', r₂)) = if r₁ = r₁' then -D.second r₂ c₂ else 0

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.check_quotient_semantics
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  (Matrix.toLin' (Paper.HGP.xChecks H)).ker = (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleCycleCode.carrier ∧
    (Matrix.toLin' (Paper.HGP.zChecks H).transpose).range =
        (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleBoundaryCode.carrier ∧
      (Matrix.toLin' (Paper.HGP.zChecks H)).ker =
          (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleCocycleCode.carrier ∧
        (Matrix.toLin' (Paper.HGP.xChecks H).transpose).range =
          (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).firstCoboundaryCheckCode.carrier

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.zChecks_blocks
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  (∀ (c : C₁) (r : R₂) (a : C₁) (b : C₂),
      Paper.HGP.zChecks H (c, r) (Sum.inl (a, b)) = if a = c then H.second r b else 0) ∧
    ∀ (c : C₁) (r : R₂) (a : R₁) (b : R₂),
      Paper.HGP.zChecks H (c, r) (Sum.inr (a, b)) = if b = r then H.first a c else 0

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.checks_commute
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  Paper.HGP.xChecks H * (Paper.HGP.zChecks H).transpose = 0

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.parameters
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  Fintype.card (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.QubitIndex R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂) =
      Fintype.card C₁ * Fintype.card C₂ + Fintype.card R₁ * Fintype.card R₂ ∧
    Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleHomology =
        QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstCode H) *
            QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondCode H) +
          QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstTransposeCode H) *
            QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondTransposeCode H) ∧
      Module.finrank (ZMod 2) (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleCohomology =
        QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstCode H) *
            QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondCode H) +
          QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.firstTransposeCode H) *
            QEC.Coding.Dimension (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.secondTransposeCode H)

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.representative_weight_lower_bound
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂)
  (v : QEC.Coding.Word (ZMod 2) (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.QubitIndex R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂)),
  v ∈ (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleCycleCode.carrier ∧
        v ∉ (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleBoundaryCode.carrier ∨
      v ∈ (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).middleCocycleCode.carrier ∧
        v ∉ (QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.chainComplex H).firstCoboundaryCheckCode.carrier →
    QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.inputDistanceMinimum H ≤ ↑(QEC.Coding.HammingWeight v)

declarations.name: Paper.HGP.xChecks_blocks
declarations.type:
∀ {R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂ : Type u} [inst : Fintype R₁] [inst_1 : DecidableEq R₁] [inst_2 : Fintype C₁] [inst_3 : DecidableEq C₁]
  [inst_4 : Fintype R₂] [inst_5 : DecidableEq R₂] [inst_6 : Fintype C₂] [inst_7 : DecidableEq C₂]
  (H : QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.Data (ZMod 2) R₁ C₁ R₂ C₂),
  (∀ (r : R₁) (c : C₂) (a : C₁) (b : C₂),
      Paper.HGP.xChecks H (r, c) (Sum.inl (a, b)) = if c = b then H.first r a else 0) ∧
    ∀ (r : R₁) (c : C₂) (a : R₁) (b : R₂),
      Paper.HGP.xChecks H (r, c) (Sum.inr (a, b)) = if r = a then H.second b c else 0

declarations.name: QEC.Coding.HypergraphProduct.boundary1Matrix.eq_1

declarations.name: Paper.cohomology_finrank_eq_homology
declarations.type:

declarations.type:
